Zero the center: Set the element at the center index `(size // 2, size // 2, size // 2)` to 0.

Normalize: Divide all elements by the sum of all elements (excluding the center if it was zeroed before summation, or including it if zeroed after, but since center is 0, it doesn't affect the sum) to ensure the kernel sums to 1.
